mapper.select: SELECT FROM pricing_scheme_factor_value WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
SELECT FROM pricing_scheme_factor_value WHERE scheme_id=#{schemeId} AND is_deleted=0 ORDER BY factor_code
mapper.update: UPDATE pricing_scheme_factor_value v SET v.value_json=#{valueJson},v.row_version=v.row_version+1 WHERE v.id=#{id} AND v.row_version=#{rowVersion} AND v.is_deleted=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pricing_scheme s WHERE s.id=v.scheme_id AND s.status='DRAFT' AND s.is_deleted=0)

UPDATE pricing_scheme_factor_value v SET v.is_deleted=1,v.row_version=v.row_version+1 WHERE v.id=#{id} AND v.row_version=#{rowVersion} AND v.is_deleted=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pricing_scheme s WHERE s.id=v.scheme_id AND s.status='DRAFT' AND s.is_deleted=0)
